resources.string: Try this if the PC connects but nothing ever plays, or if Windows cannot create the COM port. Secure is the default and stays the right choice when it works.
Bluetooth permission denied. Without it this app cannot open a socket at all.
Setting this up the first time

1. Pair. Press Make discoverable, then pair from the PC.

2. Start. Press Start listening. The service must be running before the next step - Windows finds the port by querying the phone, so a port that is not open cannot be listed.

3. Map a COM port. On Windows: Bluetooth settings → More Bluetooth options → COM Ports tab → Add → Outgoing → pick the phone → pick the service PC Audio In. Note the COM number.

4. Send. Run the PowerShell sender with that COM port.

No Wi-Fi, no router, no internet, no cable, and no mobile data is touched: this is a point-to-point socket, not a network.
